proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E153 (Carbon Black)
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E153 (carbon black / vegetable carbon) as Mushbooh (doubtful): it is charred material of animal or vegetable origin (bone char vs wood/plant), so the source must be verified to determine halal status.

proposed.sourceName: Islam Q&A — Fatwa 233750 'Ruling on sugar refined using bone char'
proposed.paraphrase: Holds that bones burned into charcoal/ash undergo istihalah (complete transformation) and thereby become pure (tahir) and permissible — the view of the Hanafi and Maliki schools and the Permanent Committee, favored by Ibn Taymiyyah and Ibn al-Qayyim — regardless of the bones' original source.
